description: This Java source file defines the class WebModuleUtil, which provides utility methods for managing web modules within the OpenMRS platform. The class handles starting and stopping modules, loading servlets and filters, managing the web application context, and interacting with module configurations and related resources.

classes.name: WebModuleUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for managing modules, servlets, filters, and context refreshes within the OpenMRS web application environment.

methods.name: startModule
methods.description: Handles startup procedures for a module, including copying resource files, configuring DWR, and loading servlets and filters, optionally delaying context refresh.

methods.name: stopModule
methods.description: Reverses activities done during module startup, including removing servlets, filters, and tasks, and updating configuration files.

methods.name: loadServlets
methods.description: Parses module configuration to instantiate and register servlets defined within a module.

methods.name: unloadServlets
methods.description: Removes and destroys servlets associated with a specified module.

methods.name: loadFilters
methods.description: Loads and initializes filters per module configuration, manages filter mappings.

methods.name: unloadFilters
methods.description: Unloads and destroys filters associated with a specified module.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns all registered filters, across modules.

methods.name: getFiltersForRequest
methods.description: Determines applicable filters for a specific HTTP request.

methods.name: refreshWAC
methods.description: Refreshes the Spring WebApplicationContext, reinitializing beans and request handling components.

methods.name: setDispatcherServlet
methods.description: Stores a reference to the main DispatcherServlet.

methods.name: setStaticDispatcherServlet
methods.description: Stores a reference to the static content DispatcherServlet.

methods.name: getServlet
methods.description: Retrieves a servlet by its name.

methods.name: getModuleWebFolder
methods.description: Provides the filesystem path to a module's web resources directory.
